review_questions: Independently assess whether provider-neutral v3 preserves exact ReviewRequest provider/model binding and cannot silently substitute Groq for Gemini or vice versa.
Verify Groq and Gemini share the same v2 evidence materialization and semantic validation contract while provider invocation and authenticated execution envelopes remain distinct.
